title: How Far the Cancellation Rate Exceeds the Threshold: Decision Table for Wayfare Warning Numbers
content:
For **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreements, the amount by which a Wayfare driver's cancellation rate exceeds the level's threshold raises the cancellation warning sequence number, the number a cancellation-rate warning carries within the driver's current warning cycle.

## Rule

When the cancellation rate at the latest rating review exceeds the level's cancellation rate threshold by at least 2.0 percentage points, a continued or recounted cancellation warning sequence number gains 2; when it exceeds it by at least 1.0 but fewer than 2.0 points, the number gains 1; when it exceeds it by fewer than 1.0 points, the number gains nothing. Rates are compared at one decimal place as recorded. A number that starts a fresh cycle is one and gains nothing.

The excess is the cancellation rate shown at the latest rating review on the standing record less the cancellation rate threshold of the agreement's level, taken at one decimal place.

## Thresholds by level

| Service level | Cancellation rate threshold (percent) | Excess of 1.0 point reached at | Excess of 2.0 points reached at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Standard | 10.00 | 11.0 | 12.0 |
| Wayfare Green | 10.00 | 11.0 | 12.0 |
| Wayfare Comfort | 8.00 | 9.0 | 10.0 |
| Wayfare XL | 8.00 | 9.0 | 10.0 |
| Wayfare Black | 6.00 | 7.0 | 8.0 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 6.00 | 7.0 | 8.0 |

## Decision table

| Excess over the level's threshold | Gain to a continued or recounted number |
|---|---|
| 2.0 points or more | 2 |
| 1.0 to 1.9 points | 1 |
| 0.9 points or less | 0 |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical, Wayfare XL, threshold 8.00)

| Latest review cancellation rate | Excess | Gain |
|---|---|---|
| 10.0 | 2.0 | 2 |
| 9.9 | 1.9 | 1 |
| 9.0 | 1.0 | 1 |
| 8.9 | 0.9 | 0 |
